aba: a- — to be, to dwell; past -ba, 'dwelt' (verb, past tense) [住了] · also after the converb meden, 'was ruling, ruled' (meden aba; Ming 管 有來), a- as 'be' (verb, auxiliary past) · also nögčin aba, 'was passing on' (a- as 'be', past; Ming 有來)
böġed: bü- — to be; ending -ġed, 'being so, even so', uncertain (verb, converb) [便] · also read as a particle of sequence, 'and then, thereupon' (Ming 便), as in süni böġed 'then in the night' · also (Ming 見有 'being, there being') 'being so'
kikün: ki- — to do; future participle -kün, 'shall do' (verb, participle; in ker kikün 'how shall (we) do'; the Ming 怎飮 uses 飮 'drink' only to write the sound kün) [怎飮]
turuγad: turuγ — lean; plural -ad, 'the lean ones' (adjective + plural; Ming 痩每) [痩每]
jakikün: jaki- — to do what, to do (ya- 'what' + ki- 'do'); future participle -kün, 'what shall (one) do?' (interrogative verb, participle) [做甚]
üges: üge — word, saying; plural -s, 'words' (noun + plural) [言語每]
sonosču: sonos- — to hear, listen; converb -ču, 'hearing' (verb, converb) [聽着]
keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
belgütei: Belgütei — Belgütei, a man's name (personal name; Ming (兒)名, a son) [(兒)名]
amitu: amitu — living, alive (adjective; amin 'life' + possessive -tu) [活的]
böġetele: bü- — to be (böġe- before an ending); converb -tele, 'while, although' (verb, converb) [旣]
nökör-e: nökör — companion, comrade; dative-locative -e, 'to a companion' (noun + case; Ming 伴當行) [伴當行]
abdaγ̇asu: ab- — to take; passive -da-, 'be taken'; conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (one) is taken' (verb, passive conditional; Ming 被要了呵) [被要了呵]
aγsan: a- — to be, to dwell; -γsan: past participle: ...-ed (the one that was) [住的]
tusa: tusa — use, help, benefit (noun; Ming 濟) [濟] · also Ming 恩 'favour, kindness'
üküġesü: ükü- — to die; conditional converb -ġesü, 'if (he) dies' (verb, converb) [死呵]
taki: taki — also, again, too (particle; Ming 也) [也]
nigen: nigen — one, a [一] · also 'together, as one' (Ming 一同) · also 'one, a' with Ming 一箇, before the thing counted
ne: -(n)e — dative-locative: at, in, to (front-vowel form) [行] · also on names, De-Sečen-(n)e and Höġelün-(n)e, 'to De-Sechen, to Högelün' (Ming 行), where the (n) is Shiratori's · also -(n)e after küġün (küġün-(n)e), the agent after a passive, 'by a person' (Ming 被人行) · also müren-(n)e, 'to the river' (müren ends in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 河 行)
kebteġesü: kebte- — to lie down; conditional converb -ġesü, 'if / when he lay' (verb, conditional) [臥着呵]
ülü-ü: ülü — not; followed by -ü, a particle of question (uncertain; the Ming puts its 麽 on the next word) (negative particle + particle) [不]
irge: irge — wether, castrated ram (noun; Ming 羯羊) [羯羊] · also 'people' (Ming 百姓), a form of irgen, as in tede irge ičuγaγad 'those people, having turned back'
ügülen: ügüle- — to speak, say; converb -n, 'saying' (verb, converb; Ming 說) [說]
ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
šiqan: šiqa- — to lean against, keep close to (stem inferred; Ming 挨); -n: converb: -ing [挨着]
morilažu: morin — horse; verb-forming -la-, converb -žu, 'mounting' (noun-derived verb, converb) [上馬着]
oduγ̇asu: od- — to go (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 去); conditional -uγ̇asu, 'if one goes' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form; Ming 呵) [去呵]
aduγ̇un: aduγ̇un — herd of horses (noun) [馬羣] · also 'livestock, beasts' (Ming 頭口), olžalaγsad aduγ̇un 'the livestock of those who had taken spoil'
ordo: ordo — palace (noun; Ming 宮室 'palace') [宮室]
müd: müd — they (third-person plural; Ming 他每) (pronoun; the exact form is uncertain) [他每]
morilaja: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb: to ride; hortative -ja, 'let us mount' (noun-derived verb, hortative, first person plural) [上馬咱]
